import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import binarize
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Prepare data
X = train_df["comment_text"].fillna(" ").values
y = train_df[target_cols].values
X_test = test_df["comment_text"].fillna(" ").values

# TF-IDF vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english",
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
tfidf.fit(X)
X_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_test)

# Stratified train-validation split (80-20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_tfidf,
    y,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=np.argmax(y, axis=1) if y.sum() > 0 else None,
)

# Store predictions for validation and test
val_preds = np.zeros((X_val.shape[0], len(target_cols)))
test_preds = np.zeros((X_test_tfidf.shape[0], len(target_cols)))

# Train models for each target
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    # Train Logistic Regression with class weighting
    lr = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0,
        class_weight="balanced",
        max_iter=100,
        solver="lbfgs",
        n_jobs=-1,
        verbose=0,
    )
    lr.fit(X_train, y_train[:, i])

    # Train SGDClassifier with log loss for probability estimates
    sgd = SGDClassifier(
        loss="log",
        penalty="l2",
        alpha=1e-4,
        class_weight="balanced",
        max_iter=100,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=0,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    sgd.fit(X_train, y_train[:, i])

    # Predict on validation and test sets, average probabilities
    val_lr = lr.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    val_sgd = sgd.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    val_preds[:, i] = (val_lr + val_sgd) / 2

    test_lr = lr.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    test_sgd = sgd.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    test_preds[:, i] = (test_lr + test_sgd) / 2

# Compute column-wise ROC AUC on validation set
col_auc = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i])
    col_auc.append(auc)

mean_auc = np.mean(col_auc)
print(f"Validation mean column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"].values})
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    submission[col] = test_preds[:, i]

# Ensure submission path exists and save
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
